title: Helpdesk agent
description: Requests, latency and cost filtered to the Helpdesk-shaped routing aliases (agent-default, agent-strong, embed - from this repo's routing.yaml), pod health for the three Helpdesk workloads, and stuck chats read from the help desk's own counters: how each turn ended, how many turns it took to file a request, and how many chats wait on a question for 30 minutes or more. Provisioned from infra/k8s/monitoring/dashboards/; edits made in the Grafana UI are not saved.

panels.title: Requests per second, by alias
panels.description: Requests routed to a Helpdesk-shaped alias, by status. Reads empty until the companion Helpdesk repo sends traffic.

panels.title: Latency p50 and p95, by alias
panels.description: End-to-end duration for Helpdesk-shaped aliases. Reads empty until the companion repo sends traffic.

panels.title: Cost per second, by provider and model
panels.description: gateway_cost_usd_total carries no alias label (only tenant, provider and model), so this panel cannot be scoped to Helpdesk-shaped aliases and shows total gateway spend for context instead - it will overcount once other traffic exists alongside Helpdesk's, and narrows to Helpdesk-only spend only once a dedicated tenant is created for it.

panels.title: Pod restarts, Helpdesk workloads
panels.description: Container restart count for helpdesk-api, helpdesk-worker and helpdesk-scheduler. Reads empty until the companion Helpdesk repo's four workloads exist in the cluster (STATUS: images not yet built).

panels.title: Pod phase, Helpdesk workloads
panels.description: 1 when a Helpdesk pod is in the given phase, 0 otherwise. Reads empty until those pods exist.

panels.title: Turn endings per second, by how they ended
panels.description: How each help desk turn ended (answered, asked a question, refused, failed and so on), from the agent API's own counter. A rise in questions or refusals is where chats get stuck.

panels.title: Turns to file a request, p50 and p95
panels.description: How many of the person's messages it took before a request was filed, from the agent API's histogram over the last hour.

panels.title: Chats waiting on a question for 30 minutes or more
panels.description: Chats whose last turn asked the person something and got no answer for 30 minutes or more, from the scheduler's sweep. Summed over every tenant, because the gauge's tenant label is an id, not a name.
